issues.description: Class/method: Animal.messageOnFeed(). Problem statement (UML) declares the method as public abstract (UML shows "+ messageOnFeed(): String", problem_statement.md line 28). The solution implementation declares it as protected: "protected abstract String messageOnFeed();" in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java (line 18). This visibility difference between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended access level and whether they should declare/override the method as public or protected.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either (A) change the solution signature to public: in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java replace "protected abstract String messageOnFeed();" with "public abstract String messageOnFeed();" so it matches the UML and problem text, or (B) if protected was intended, update the UML/problem statement to indicate a protected abstract method and note this in the task description so students know the intended access level.
